label: Vacant dwellings 1st of March and 1st of September in multi-dwelling buildings in municipal housing companies by region and year of completion 2019-2024
note: As from 2019, statistics are also reported on the greater Malmö region. Up to and including 2017, these 12 municipalities were included in the regions Municipalities with more than 75 000 inhabitants (Malmö, Lund) and Municipalities with fewer than 75 000 inhabitants (Staffanstorp, Burlöv, Vellinge, Kävlinge, Lomma, Svedala, Skurup, Höör, Eslöv, Trelleborg).

Only dwellings available on the open market are included. Special housing like senior-, service-, staff- and student housing are not included.

Rented dwellings in one- or two- dwellings owned by municipal housing companies  are including. Also a few dwellings in special housing may be included in some of the numbers for municipal housing companies.
